Phone validation uses libphonenumber-js 1.13.15, max browser bundle.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/libphonenumber-js/v/1.13.15
Documentation: https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js
License: MIT; see libphonenumber-LICENSE.

The bundle is stored locally so phone validation does not require a CDN request.
The max metadata checks country-specific number lengths and digit patterns.
Update the bundle when numbering plans change. Format validation does not verify
that a person owns a number.
